criteria.question: Does the company sell its own products directly to consumers online?
Is there evidence of customer support load, such as a help center, FAQ, returns or shipping policy, live chat, or support hiring?
Are there growth signals, such as new products or markets, hiring, funding or expansion?
Does it sell a sizable or varied catalog (many products, variants or bundles)?
Is it a small or mid-sized brand rather than a global giant with large in-house AI teams?
Does the company sell software to businesses?
Is there evidence of customer support or onboarding load, such as help docs, a support center or customer success roles?
Are there growth signals, such as hiring, funding, new products or new markets?
Does it run workflows AI could automate, such as onboarding, support, sales operations or data entry?
Is it a startup or mid-sized company rather than a global giant with large in-house AI teams?
Does the company provide marketing, creative or development services to clients?
Is there evidence of many clients, such as case studies, client logos or testimonials?
Does it deliver repeatable work AI could speed up, such as reporting, content production, SEO or lead generation?
Are there growth signals, such as hiring, new services or new offices?
Is it a small or mid-sized agency rather than a global holding-company network?
